title: Template: fill in the BFS loop

solution.explanation: Correct. popleft takes the vertex that has waited longest, and not in skips a vertex that has already been found.

1.pop: Not quite. pop takes the newest vertex from the back, so the queue acts like a stack and the order is no longer BFS. Take the vertex that has waited longest.

2.in: Not quite. With in, only vertices already found are added again, and new ones are never found. Add a neighbour only if it has not been found yet.

hints.body: A queue is first in, first out.
Blank 1 takes a vertex from the front of the queue. Blank 2 decides whether a neighbour is new.
Answer: blank 1 is popleft, and blank 2 is not in. So v = queue.popleft(), and if n not in found: adds only new neighbours.
